newActualIndividuals.note: Registered new actual IDs with generation>0; same-ID transfer is not birth; egg inoculum alone is not actual offspring.

inocula.note: Appearance/transition/removal are registry observations. Removal is not automatically establishment or death; P releasedE is energy, not count.

limitations: Flows and ID transitions are measured evidence, not same-lineage completed-lifecycle certification.
Q stock states are read from product observations.hyperParasite.states; runner biology.Qstates may be null and is not zero-filled.
Initial free Q survival and initial absence are separate from next-generation renewal / maintenance failure.
Open windows count actual terminal-P time opportunities, not sensed or reachable targets.
